snippet.title: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping Developer Presentation - Future Games Show Summer Showcase
snippet.description:
A quacking trailer for Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping gave us a closer look at the game’s point-and-click gameplay, as well as its cast of quirky anthropomorphic characters. It’s out now on PC and consoles, and a Simplified Chinese language update is coming later this year.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #duckdetective 

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
